claims.text: Mexican trial [W4311938754]; preprint of the same trial [W6901825914]
claims.label: supported

claims.text: | **PRINCIPLE** (UK) [W4392303143] | Open-label platform trial; 2,157 on ivermectin vs 3,256 on usual care | 300–400 µg/kg × 3 days | Self-reported recovery was about 2 days faster (hazard ratio 1.15, 1.07–1.23). But the chance of reaching the pre-specified meaningful effect (hazard ratio ≥ 1.2) was only 0.19. No difference in hospitalization or death (odds ratio 1.02); 6-month recovery 74.3% vs 71.2%. Authors' conclusion: "unlikely to provide clinically meaningful improvement." |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: All figures (n, dose, HR 1.15, 0.192 probability, OR 1.02, 74.3% vs 71.2%, conclusion) match the PRINCIPLE abstract.
